# 0xdawg.com / Dawid Golebiewski

> Hamburg-, DACH-, and EU-relevant enterprise AI, data, workflow, and technical due diligence consulting for teams that need AI initiatives to become trusted delivery and measurable business value.

## Services / Leistungen

- [Enterprise AI, Data, and Workflow Consulting](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/): Homepage covering enterprise AI delivery, workflow redesign, shared-context problems, validation bottlenecks, and how stuck initiatives are turned into executable delivery.
- [Diagnosis, Scope, Delivery](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/#approach): Core consulting approach for diagnosing AI and process bottlenecks, refitting shared context, and delivering validated implementations with knowledge transfer.
- [Technical Due Diligence](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/technical-due-diligence): Offer for buyers, founders, and operators who need architecture review, delivery-risk assessment, hidden process debt analysis, and checks on whether a claimed AI advantage is durable.
- [Start a Project Conversation](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/#contact): Contact entry point for stuck AI, workflow, automation, or due diligence initiatives via booking link or email.

## Track Record / Projekterfahrung

- [Enterprise AI Track Record](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/#experience): Reverse-chronology experience spanning AIR / AI-Raadgivning, NATIX GmbH, DLR, and Amazon Robotics across enterprise AI, robotics, computer vision, sensor data, and R&D delivery.
- [Best-Fit Engagements](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/#fit-title): Defines the initiatives most likely to succeed: owned, budgeted, execution-critical work where AI access exists but business value still fails to appear.
- [AI Failure Pattern Framework](https://solutions.0xdawg.com/#proof-heading): Diagnostic overview of six operating failures that stall enterprise AI adoption, including unclear expectations, pre-AI workflows, weak shared context, cleanup load, and premature cost pressure.
